central_invariant: An independently issued date precedes the first generation query; common native RCC-governed read-only history precedes one immutable protected candidate; both arms receive that candidate/pre-state; actual native result and arm-local state feed terminal generation without another effect or retry.

trajectory_profile.scope: Exact Task4 request, pinned AgentDojo banking simulator, native AgentDojo-compatible generation query seam; not the frozen Final128 CLI.
trajectory_profile.date_issuance: The unchanged #208 prepare method issues context before the generator wrapper starts. Its date becomes a trusted system metadata message before the first native-compatible generation query.
trajectory_profile.common_prefix: Native SystemMessage/InitQuery, bounded generation queries and ToolsExecutor; six fixed read-only tools only, through pinned RCCOnlyExecutor and governed FunctionsRuntime. Every read must leave immediate pre-state unchanged.
trajectory_profile.protected_capture: First send_money proposal ends the common prefix; unchanged #208 native normalization/capture retains both eligible and ineligible candidates. No scorer/gold access, repair or eligibility filtering.
trajectory_profile.native_dispatch: Reuse the exact #208 _DateExecutor via pinned RCC governed FunctionsRuntime on each arm's detached pre-state, and reserve the same runner arm-attempt registry. A remains RCC-only; B keeps authenticated date, Authority, policy, drift, risk and final dispatch checks.
trajectory_profile.protected_tool_result: Use the actual native run_function return tuple, actual GovernanceStop/date refusal and native tool_result_to_str to append a native ChatToolResultMessage. No result inferred from scores, expected outcomes or an artificial success string.
trajectory_profile.continuation: One separate generation query per arm sees its own actual tool result and post-state; accepts terminal text only. Additional tool/effect requests fail closed and preserve any preceding effect as an explicit partial execution, never a safety success.
trajectory_profile.generation_runtime: Advertises pinned native tools, but run_function rejects all execution. Detached environment/history are supplied; rewritten history, replacement runtime/environment and observed state/tool-map mutation are rejected.
trajectory_profile.batch_and_nested_calls: Unsupported in this bounded single-tool message profile; reject before native execution.
trajectory_profile.query_limits: At most eight common generation queries, then one terminal query per arm; no automatic retry, fallback or second refund.
trajectory_profile.date_ttl: One issued context covers the state-preserving prefix; the V1 profile revalidates authentication/freshness at capture and B dispatch. Expiry aborts capture or refuses B; it never permits repairing the candidate.
trajectory_profile.pairing_evidence: Same common history hash, proposal ordinal, immediate pre-state, normalized candidate hash and authenticated-context/control pairing identity; identical protected RCC review before B treatment.
trajectory_profile.measurement_boundary: Candidate-level treatment evidence is the fixed protected candidate. Independent continuation queries can vary and are explicitly excluded from a candidate-only treatment claim. No utility/security measurement is produced here.

trust_assumptions: Inherit #207/#208 trusted harness key/clock ownership, original request and structured state provenance, code/policy integrity and pinned native simulator scope.

The supplied generation element is trusted Python transport code; model/tool contents cannot access issuer/session keys/registry or execute arbitrary Python. No arbitrary callback-code compromise protection is claimed.
Fixture generation is scripted, provider-free development evidence, not independent external or held-out validation and not physical-time attestation.
